options.content:
**Internal DNS:** dns-1, dns-2 and dns-3 run independent BIND instances for internal names. Current configuration serves `cbannister.casa`, `unifi` and local reverse zones. These are separate fault domains from Kubernetes. VM panels use DNSdist observations; native BIND zone serials and transfer counters are not yet collected.

**Cluster-managed DNS:** the Kubernetes BIND primary and two secondaries serve `cbannister.xyz` and `rociobolanos.com` for cluster-managed resources. Serial comparison applies only within this replication group.

**Planned DHCP reverse zones:** a new BIND on the gateway will own DHCP reverse zones and transfer them to the DNS VM BIND servers. The gateway is not yet deployed or monitored here. Once available, compare gateway and VM serials only for these transferred reverse zones; keep internal forward zones and cluster-managed zones separate.
